verdict.rationale: Buying registered-agent service is a core capability for a product like CT Corporation, so the story applies. The evidence pack has only two robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into it. No page content describes online purchase, same-day delivery of the agent name and street address, or support for formation or change filings.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day
